teacher_info.intro:
After 25 years working in Information Technology (IT), I discovered that what I really wanted to do was to help people learn. For the last few years, I have been helping people like you become more confident speakers, regardless of the language they are learning - this, through one-on-one teaching and conversation practice here on italki.
I have been tutoring foreign languages part time since 1998. In 2016, I got involved full time, started teaching ESL locally, and mentored under the best teachers I could find. Learning and teaching Esperanto has broadened my knowledge of my own native English, and helped me learn how to explain things in a clear and understandable way.
teacher_info.introduction: In university, I completed a minor in German. Many of my friends were international students, often with limited English skills. I took pride in my ability to adapt my language to the appropriate level as they progressed. I learned Esperanto by email, but very soon my wife and I got involved with the community. We regularly sought opportunities to speak face to face. In a short time, the people I considered my mentors were seeking my input on how to express fine shades of meaning. Through two decades, I have seen a broad range of backgrounds. Different explanations work for different people. Some aspects need more attention. Some common explanations are actually best avoided. Since Esperanto was our home language, I have accumulated songs, games, and other methods that are suitable for younger children. M y 11 year old son and I created a course. I volunteer with the boy scouts, teaching and mentoring boys from 6-17. Through organizing Esperanto events, I have the opportunity to work with both beginners and more experienced self-learners who find themselves speaking Esperanto for the first time. This can be scary, but we've all been there. I can help you over these jitters, and to move beyond translating phrases to actively thinking in the language. This is an exciting time for Esperanto. New technology allows us not only to read and write, but for conversation as well. You need a teacher with experience actually speaking the language. It's good to start with good pronunciation, but it's never too late. NOTE FOR ENGLISH LEARNERS: Although my profile emphasizes other languages, I want you to know that I take teaching English seriously. I teach English locally and work with students from total beginner to near-native - ages 8 to 80. I will encourage you to work on your communication skills and being understood. I will also provide feedback on one or two things you can work on. I invite you to read the comments by others who have learned English with me.

I teach both formal grammar, as well as common grammatical conventions. In these lessons we can also work on expanding your vocabulary and learning proper word and phrase usage.

I will also assign corresponding  homework assignments to be done outside of class to maximize your learning. pro_course_detail.title: Formal Teaching | Business English | English Pronunciation | Situational English - Formal Teaching for Adults
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to Your Personalized English Learning Journey!

This course is designed to help you improve your vocabulary, pronunciation, conversation skills, and grammar. I have a pre-designed curriculum that I tailor specifically to your needs and goals. If you have particular areas you’d like to focus on—such as business English, preparing for job interviews, or acing university interviews—just let me know, and we’ll incorporate that into our lessons.

We’ll also practice everyday scenarios, like talking on the phone, scheduling appointments, or dining out, so you can build confidence in real-life situations.

One of our key focuses will be pronunciation, especially tricky sounds like TH, PH, DH, H, L, and the American R. I know these can be challenging—especially that American R—but I promise, our lessons are fun and encouraging. You’ll leave feeling more confident and ready to speak with ease.

Please note that I teach adults only.
Let’s learn and grow together—message me today to get started!

pro_course_detail.description:
When learning a language, it is important to also learn cultural and historical context in order to fully engage with native speakers. We will discuss over 22 key points in American history from the 1500's to modern day. In doing so, we will also learn American English expressions, idioms, and phrasal verbs. 

In this class, you will have movies (if you rather books, let me know) and TV shows as homework to broaden your understanding of the lessons.  I also will give youtube video homework as a fun way to explore the language and history as well. 

* I only teach adults and will confirm you are an adult before our class. If you do not confirm this, I will cancel the class request.

pro_course_detail.description:
YOU DO NOT HAVE TO BUY THE BOOK, I TAKE CARE OF THAT FOR YOU! This class is for lower intermediate to advanced. The books offered in this class at this moment: Rich Dad, Poor Dad (A2-C2), Where the Crawdads Sing (B2-C2), Game of Thrones, (C1-C2) Harry Potter (B2-C2), Inkheart (B1), A Series of Unfortunate Events (A2), Wuthering Heights (B2-C2) and Coraline (A2-B1). {Add-ons: Death of the Nile, The Guest List, Angels and Demons, The Silent Patient = Thrillers} Shakespeare. pro_course_detail.title: Market Leader English
pro_course_detail.description:
I have a set of books for all levels that I share with my students called 'Market Leader'. Common topics are finance, management, marketing, sales, business meetings, business communication, making presentations, and business social interaction.

One of the best aspects of the books is that they set up 'role play' situations where the student and I must act out some roles in business interaction, negotiation, bargaining for a sale, etc. The book also has a lot of interesting discussion topics and business articles which give us a lot of material for discussion. Lastly there are 'live situation' listening samples from people in business which cover a wide range of the different English accents and non-native European accents in English.
